Agent-readable navigation layer for scopes, required tasks, source-use boundaries, and missing-data checklist; not a new authority source.
Three required detailed-design key area boundaries (provisional).
Official announcement: project name, organizers, scope levels, three key areas, required depth (detailed regulatory-planning urban design), language and deliverable context.
Agent-facing open-call principles, six required agent tasks, scenario/branding/operation requirements, and boundary clause.

Background for the Jing-Zhang Railway heritage narrative: the railway was China's first self-designed and self-built railway, completed under Zhan Tianyou in 1909. Used only as heritage/cultural narrative context within the site; no legal or engineering claim is attached.
sources.notes: The 9 km heritage-park timeline and four-epoch narrative are treated as design/cultural narrative, not as measured historical statistics. A3/A0 do not repeat any unsourced figures (e.g. 174 km, 100+ artifacts, 350 km/h, 'world-first smart HSR').

sources.usage: International benchmark districts (Sand Hill Road, London King's Cross, Cornell Tech Roosevelt Island, Singapore one-north, Tokyo Marunouchi) are used only as illustrative planning analogies for spatial logic (capital-talent link, heritage-to-knowledge conversion, campus-park-community, green campus, corporate-headquarters gathering). They are not cited as measured statistics and do not imply any legal or planning commitment.
sources.notes: Listed in proposal.md section '发展愿景：对标国际知名科技城区' as analogy only. No specific measured figures are attributed to these districts.

sources.usage: Professional standards matrix basis: urban-design measures, regulatory detailed-planning depth, and land-use classification terminology. Mapped in standard_matrix.json.
AI-governance, accessibility and inclusive-service standards used for scenario cards and public-interest safeguards. Boundaries are respected as registered in source_registry.json.

claims_without_specific_source: A3/A0 do not assert 174 km, 100+ historical artifacts, 350 km/h design speed, or 'world-first smart high-speed railway'; such assertions were removed as unsupported in the redesigned boards.

Enterprise and institution locations (e.g. Tsinghua, Peking University, ByteDance, Baidu, Kuaishou) are referenced as general geographic context from the official announcement's scope description and treated as background; no floor-area, headcount or land-use figures are attributed to them.
